task: Make expression-tree retention the default while keeping shadow mode as the legacy-parser cross-check configuration.
observation: The change required updating active tooling harnesses that explicitly selected MOSS_EST=off; otherwise the test suite would keep exercising the retired mode instead of the new default. Registering the suite as an unset-environment pass plus a shadow pass made the default-mode coverage explicit.
impact: A mode-default change can leave apparently passing test coverage on an obsolete path unless the harness environment is audited together with the mode selector.

resolution.summary: Active harnesses were updated to use the default environment or MOSS_EST=shadow, and make check now invokes both configurations.
